available_exploration_history.hypothesis: Prioritizing navigation to an open surface receptacle first avoids the overhead of opening closed storage receptacles, yielding faster target acquisition when the object may be resting on a visible surface.
available_exploration_history.realization_pattern: Navigate to an open surface receptacle from the room center, inspect for the target object type, and take it if found; otherwise abort local probe.
available_exploration_history.scope: ALFWorld pick-clean-then-place tasks where the target object type is known but not visible at room center, and open surface receptacles are available in the admissible action list.

available_exploration_history.hypothesis: Prioritizing navigation to a cooling appliance receptacle first, rather than searching open surfaces or closed storage receptacles, yields faster target acquisition because bread is semantically likely to be stored inside a cooling appliance when the task requires cooling it.
available_exploration_history.realization_pattern: Navigate to a cooling appliance receptacle from the room center, open it if closed, inspect for the target object type, and take it if found; otherwise abort local probe.
available_exploration_history.scope: ALFWorld pick-cool-then-place tasks where the target object is not initially visible and a cooling appliance receptacle is available in the admissible action list from room center.

available_exploration_history.hypothesis: Prioritizing navigation to a closed storage receptacle that also serves as a heating appliance (e.g., a microwave) tests whether the target object can be found and immediately heated at the same location, reducing total traversal steps compared to searching open surfaces first.
available_exploration_history.realization_pattern: Navigate from room center to a closed heating-capable storage receptacle, open it, inspect contents, and acquire the target object if found; otherwise terminate the local probe.
available_exploration_history.scope: ALFWorld pick-heat-then-place tasks where the target object is not visible at room center and closed cold-storage or heating receptacles are available in the admissible action list.

available_exploration_history.hypothesis: Prioritizing navigation to a closed storage receptacle first, rather than an open surface, yields faster target acquisition for objects typically stored inside enclosed spaces like bathrooms.
available_exploration_history.realization_pattern: Select a closed storage receptacle from the visible list as the first navigation target instead of following strict observation order or prioritizing open surfaces; navigate to it, open it, inspect for the target object, acquire if present, otherwise close it and halt the local probe.
available_exploration_history.scope: ALFWorld pick-and-place tasks where the target object is not immediately visible at room center and closed storage receptacles are listed in the entry observation.

available_exploration_history.hypothesis: Prioritizing navigation to a closed storage receptacle first, rather than an open surface, yields faster target acquisition for objects typically stored inside enclosed containers like mugs.
available_exploration_history.realization_pattern: Navigate to a closed storage receptacle from the entry state, open it, inspect contents for the target object type, and take the object if present; otherwise halt the local probe.
available_exploration_history.scope: ALFWorld pick-clean-then-place tasks where the target object type is known but not visible at room center, and closed storage receptacles are available in the admissible action list.

functional_contract.available_state: Agent at room center with full list of visible receptacles from entry observation; target not yet visible; inventory empty.
constraints: Must follow the exact listing order from the initial room observation
Must open closed receptacles before inspecting contents
Must pick up the target immediately upon first exposure
Must not perform actions outside the probe sequence until target is acquired
functional_contract.local_function: Navigate to and inspect receptacles sequentially in the order listed in the room observation until the target object is found and picked up.
functional_contract.required_downstream_state: Agent holds the target object (soapbar) in inventory and knows its current location for subsequent navigation to cleaning/destination receptacles.
